question.en: Which jellyfish species can revert to its juvenile form, making it biologically immortal?
question.ms: Spesies obor-obor manakah boleh kembali ke bentuk juvenil, menjadikannya secara biologi hampir abadi?

funFact.en: Turritopsis dohrnii can reset its life cycle repeatedly under certain conditions.
funFact.ms: Turritopsis dohrnii boleh menetapkan semula kitaran hidupnya berulang kali dalam keadaan tertentu.

question.en: Which fish has a transparent head that allows scientists to see its brain?
question.ms: Ikan manakah mempunyai kepala lutsinar yang membolehkan saintis melihat otaknya?

funFact.en: The barreleye fish has a transparent dome covering its eyes.
funFact.ms: Ikan barreleye mempunyai kubah lutsinar yang melindungi matanya.

question.en: Which parasite can control an ant's brain and force it to climb plants before dying?
question.ms: Parasit manakah boleh mengawal otak semut dan memaksanya memanjat tumbuhan sebelum mati?

funFact.en: The fungus manipulates the ant to spread spores more effectively.
funFact.ms: Kulat ini memanipulasi semut untuk menyebarkan spora dengan lebih berkesan.

question.en: Which worm species can grow longer than a blue whale?
question.ms: Spesies cacing manakah boleh menjadi lebih panjang daripada paus biru?

funFact.en: Bootlace worms can reach lengths of over 50 meters.
funFact.ms: Cacing bootlace boleh mencapai panjang lebih 50 meter.

question.en: Which mammal has venomous spurs on its hind legs?
question.ms: Mamalia manakah mempunyai taji berbisa pada kaki belakangnya?

funFact.en: Male platypuses use venomous spurs during fights.
funFact.ms: Platipus jantan menggunakan taji berbisa semasa berlawan.

question.en: Which microorganism can survive being frozen for thousands of years and revive later?
question.ms: Mikroorganisma manakah boleh hidup selepas dibekukan selama ribuan tahun dan hidup semula?

funFact.en: Bdelloid rotifers have survived in frozen states for thousands of years.
funFact.ms: Rotifer bdelloid boleh bertahan dalam keadaan beku selama ribuan tahun.

question.en: Which bird can sleep while flying across oceans?
question.ms: Burung manakah boleh tidur semasa terbang merentasi lautan?

funFact.en: Frigatebirds can sleep with half their brain while flying.
funFact.ms: Burung frigate boleh tidur dengan separuh otaknya ketika terbang.

question.en: Which ocean creature can survive without oxygen for long periods?
question.ms: Makhluk laut manakah boleh hidup tanpa oksigen untuk tempoh lama?

funFact.en: This parasite is the first known animal that does not need oxygen to live.
funFact.ms: Parasit ini ialah haiwan pertama diketahui yang tidak memerlukan oksigen untuk hidup.

question.en: Which shark species can live for over 400 years?
question.ms: Spesies jerung manakah boleh hidup lebih 400 tahun?

funFact.en: Greenland sharks are among the longest-living vertebrates.
funFact.ms: Jerung Greenland antara vertebrata paling lama hidup.

question.en: Which plant can explode its seeds at speeds over 100 km/h?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah boleh meletupkan bijinya pada kelajuan lebih 100 km/j?

funFact.en: The sandbox tree violently ejects seeds to spread them far away.
funFact.ms: Pokok sandbox meletupkan bijinya untuk menyebarkannya jauh.

question.en: Which animal can survive complete dehydration and come back to life when rehydrated?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup selepas dehidrasi penuh dan hidup semula apabila mendapat air?

funFact.en: Tardigrades enter a state called cryptobiosis.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade memasuki keadaan dipanggil cryptobiosis.

question.en: Which mushroom glows naturally in the dark?
question.ms: Cendawan manakah bercahaya secara semula jadi dalam gelap?

funFact.en: Some fungi produce light through a chemical reaction called bioluminescence.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah kulat menghasilkan cahaya melalui tindak balas kimia dipanggil bioluminesen.

question.en: Which sea animal can clone itself repeatedly without aging?
question.ms: Haiwan laut manakah boleh menggandakan dirinya berulang kali tanpa menua?

funFact.en: It restarts its life cycle when injured or stressed.
funFact.ms: Ia memulakan semula kitaran hidup apabila cedera atau tertekan.

question.en: Which animal can shoot boiling-hot chemical spray at predators?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh menembak semburan kimia panas ke arah pemangsa?

funFact.en: The beetle mixes chemicals that explode into a hot spray.
funFact.ms: Kumbang ini mencampur bahan kimia yang meletup menjadi semburan panas.

question.en: Which deep-sea fish can expand its stomach to swallow prey bigger than itself?
question.ms: Ikan laut dalam manakah boleh mengembangkan perutnya untuk menelan mangsa lebih besar daripadanya?

funFact.en: Black swallowers can eat fish twice their size.
funFact.ms: Black swallower boleh memakan ikan dua kali saiznya.

question.en: Which animal has the fastest punch in the animal kingdom?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai pukulan paling pantas di dunia haiwan?

funFact.en: Mantis shrimp punches can create tiny shockwaves underwater.
funFact.ms: Pukulan udang mantis boleh menghasilkan gelombang kejutan kecil dalam air.

question.en: Which creature can survive being boiled at temperatures over 100°C?
question.ms: Makhluk manakah boleh hidup walaupun pada suhu lebih 100°C?

funFact.en: Pompeii worms live near hydrothermal vents in extreme heat.
funFact.ms: Cacing Pompeii hidup berhampiran lubang hidrotermal dalam haba ekstrem.

question.en: Which plant can trap and digest insects for nutrients?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah boleh menangkap dan mencerna serangga untuk nutrien?

funFact.en: Carnivorous plants evolved to survive in nutrient-poor soil.
funFact.ms: Tumbuhan karnivor berevolusi untuk hidup di tanah yang kurang nutrien.

question.en: Which animal can change its entire skin color in less than a second?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh menukar warna kulitnya dalam masa kurang satu saat?

funFact.en: Cuttlefish have special cells called chromatophores for instant camouflage.
funFact.ms: Sotong kurita mempunyai sel khas dipanggil kromatofor untuk penyamaran segera.

question.en: Which fungus species is considered the largest living organism on Earth?
question.ms: Spesies kulat manakah dianggap organisma hidup terbesar di Bumi?

funFact.en: A single Armillaria fungus in Oregon covers over 8 square kilometers.
funFact.ms: Satu kulat Armillaria di Oregon meliputi lebih 8 kilometer persegi.
